name: TanitAD HiCAP RuleBook

schema.rule_id: stable string id; NEVER reused or renamed (append-only like NodeLibrary)
schema.category: speed_limit | right_turn_on_red | priority_to_right | roundabout | emergency_vehicle | pedestrian_crossing | tram | school_bus | daytime_lights | driving_side
schema.road_type: urban | rural | expressway | motorway | junction | signalised_junction | roundabout | pedestrian_crossing | any
schema.effect: prune (numeric/candidate mask) | prior (soft knowledge, memory route) | memory (retrieval only)
schema.text: one sentence, the string embedded by the frozen text path
schema.args: numeric / categorical arguments; speeds in km/h (v_default_kmh null = no general statutory limit)
schema.source: {title, url, ref}: statute or official government page
schema.evidence: PUBLISHED (official source stated the fact) | UNVERIFIED (not confirmed from an official source in this session)
schema.verification: how the evidence class was obtained
schema.version_added: RuleBook version that introduced the record

evidence_policy: PUBLISHED here means: a WebSearch restricted to the official government/legislative domain returned the value, on 2026-10-25. Direct page fetch was blocked by the session egress proxy, so no page was read verbatim and no second independent source was sought; re-verify against the URL before quoting in the paper. UNVERIFIED values are best knowledge and must not decide a GPU-day.
